selection_rule.overshoot_aggregation_correction: An earlier draft aggregated the overshoot by the per-fold maximum. That was corrected to the fold mean before the holdout was ever run, because REPAIR GATE 2 is a single pooled number and the maximum measures between-season dispersion in the truth rather than model bias. See the OVERSHOOT_Z docstring for the numbers behind the correction.
selection_rule.primary_objective: minimise the mean absolute inner-fold error of teammate_reb_reb and teammate_ast_ast
